nights.title: The March Violets
nights.name: The March Violets
nights.extract: The March Violets are an English post-punk/gothic rock band formed in 1981 in Leeds, incorporating male and female singers, drum machine rhythms and echo-laden electric guitar, much in the style of fellow Leeds band the Sisters of Mercy. Seven March Violets singles reached the UK Indie Chart; the Natural History collection also was an indie hit.

tr.kicker: ingiliz post-punk ve gotik rock grubu · Leeds, 1981
tr.who: The March Violets, İngiliz bir post-punk ve gotik rock grubudur. 1981'de Leeds'te kuruldular ve erkek ile kadın vokalleri, davul makinesi ritimleri ve yankılı elektro gitarı bir araya getirdiler.
facts: The March Violets, 1981'de Leeds'te kurulan; erkek ve kadın vokalleri, davul makinesi ritimleri ve yankılı elektro gitarı, Leeds'li Sisters of Mercy'yi andıran bir İngiliz post-punk ve gotik rock grubudur.
Grubun yedi single'ı İngiltere Indie Listesi'ne girdi; Natural History derlemesi de bir indie hit oldu.

nights.title: Dirty Three
nights.name: Dirty Three
nights.extract: Dirty Three are an Australian instrumental rock band, consisting of Warren Ellis, Mick Turner and Jim White (drums), which formed in 1992. Their 1996 album Horse Stories was voted by Rolling Stone as one of the top three albums of the year. Two of their albums have peaked into the top 50 on the ARIA Albums Chart, Ocean Songs (1998) and Toward the Low Sun (2012). During their career they have spent much of their time overseas when not performing together. Turner is based in Melbourne, White lives in New York, and Ellis in Paris.
